result.summary: Cleans up four wallet functional tests by removing unused test nodes and an unnecessary duplicate node restart. Specifically, it eliminates node 3 from wallet_basic.py, drops the unused second node in wallet_signrawtransactionwithwallet.py and wallet_derivehdkey.py, and deletes a redundant consecutive node restart in wallet_sendall.py.
result.problem: Several wallet functional tests carry obsolete node configurations left over from earlier refactors, causing tests to start, sync, or restart daemon instances that are never checked or interacted with.
evidence: Author description: 'No coverage changes. Each test runs a bit faster, about 0.2–0.4 s per test locally.'
Commit 4f0d4e11c1 cites historical removal: 'Node 3 was last used by the resendwallettransactions check, which was removed together with the RPC in f5162458cd.'
result.card: Removes unused nodes and a redundant node restart across four wallet functional tests (wallet_basic, wallet_signrawtransactionwithwallet, wallet_derivehdkey, and wallet_sendall). These instances were left behind after previous RPC and test refactors, resulting in wasted startup and sync cycles. The change cleans up test code and saves roughly 0.2 to 0.4 seconds per test locally with no loss in test coverage.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause test failures or inadvertent loss of test coverage in wallet functional tests.
